items.question: How much bank balance must an applicant have to obtain the UAE multiple entry 5-year tourist visa?
items.gold: A bank balance of 4,000 USD or its equivalent in foreign currencies during the last six months.
items.fact: 5-year tourist visa requires 4,000 USD bank balance

items.question: How many days can GCC residents stay in the UAE after entering on an eVisa?
items.gold: 30 days from the date of entry.
items.fact: GCC resident eVisa allows 30-day stay from entry
